1778707753.1826303.description: Melodic original acoustic rock influenced by U2, John Mellencamp, Shawn Colvin, the Blue Nile, Ritchie Blackmore and Radiohead

1778868833.1875939.description: Backed by Bob Metzger on guitar and John Vandale on bass, Mark has been steadily building his fanbase around Greater Boston and beyond, as far away as England. Voted “Audience Favorite” at Linden Tree Coffeehouse, their second full-length album will be released later this year.

1778870675.1876370.description: OSR puts a rough-hewn spin on Americana; blending blues, country, and folk rock into a heartfelt mix of original sounds.

1778871002.1876502.description: Mixtape Misfits are New England's premiere 90's and 2000's rock tribute band, performing an array of high-octane hits from both iconic decades, including alternative, grunge, pop-punk, emo, and more!

1778871540.1876645.description: Eddie Miller is a Melrose based singer/songwriter and father of three, hailing originally from Long Island, New York with several twists and turns in between. He’s been playing original rock and folk going on 35 years now.

1778876285.1878197.description: We’re Antarctica!   A musical duo performing the best 60s and 70s Classic Pop Hits on keyboards/bass/vocals.  (The Music Everyone Remembers and Loves). We perform at summer concerts, farmers markets, and fairs, and we’re looking for a host planning a party or neighborhood event that needs some awesome music.

1778882153.1880404.description:
Don Nicholson and Huseyin Mehmet have been friends for more than 20 years. Don is Canadian and Hus is from the UK.
They met as scientists, both researching cures for brain diseases and ended up working together in the USA. They bonded over their love of music and have been playing together ever since. They cover both rock classics and singer-songwriter melodies. In addition to playing well-known American music (e.g. Counting Crows, Springsteen) they also cover Canadian and British bands.

1778883256.1881058.description: Shadows on the Mountain is an acoustic duo that is inspired by artists such as John Denver, Iron and Wine, Brandi Carlile, and John Mayer. They started playing music together in 2019 and have loved performing at open mics, Porchfests, and events that benefit mental health support organizations. Particularly inspired by the music and lyrics of Gregory Alan Isakov and many talented local singer-songwriters, they've made the leap from playing cover music to working on their own songs.

1778893297.1885343.description: Ahmed and his band blend the beauty of Algerian Kabyle, Raï, and Chaâbi music with a fresh modern sound. Their music brings together rich tradition, vibrant rhythms, and soulful melodies in a unique and captivating way.

1779023644.1927064.description:
THE TEAR DOWNS bring power pop, classic and indie rock with harmony-hooked lyrics onto familiar yet new ground. After two successful studio releases produced by Replacements'/
Neighborhood's David Minehan, the band released an EP and solo EPs by front man Steve Geraci and released full band mastered cuts from WMFO's 'Live Day' broadcast produced by Joel Simches WMFO, Medford, MA.

1779153053.1956889.description: Whether he's yelling it out during a heartbreaking ballad or smirking while employing a calm understated tone during a witty bluegrass number, it's all genuine.  You won’t find any flashy, feigning of desperation; no gimmicks, no overbearing nonsense during a Noel Smyth performance.  You'll see the real article.

1779295729.1996272.description:
Melrose/Beverly based duo the DTs is a newly formed act from two seasoned rock vets, Taylor Brennan and Dave Baritot, joining forces from their electric rock bands. 
Cutting their teeth with acoustic covers of popular music spanning decades, the DTs perform across the North Shore as they build out their catalog and audience.

1779298647.1997129.description: Bringing dance vibes and great music to any event, JANGO loves a variety of musical genres and eras. Can’t wait to rock this street at the upcoming Melrose Porchfest. Make plans to come and see us!

1779575691.2077250.description: Jasmine Im is a singer-songwriter living in the Boston area. She performs both original music and covers with pop and country influences. She sings, plays guitar, and also uses a loop pedal to record her own percussion and other accompaniment completely live.

1779653427.2113450.description: Stronaut has been moonlighting as a DJ for the past 2 decades. He likes to blend across multiple genres of music including drum n bass and IDM/EDM.

1779809650.2212165.description: Hi we played Melrose porchfest two years ago and have a great time.  Since our music is for 8-80 because it's diverse and fun we went over well and would love to return.

1780002612.2368082.description: We play jazz standards as well as folk, Americana, pop and bluegrass.

1780066055.2386912.other_genre: Mix of jazz, rock, pop, fusion
1780066055.2386912.description:
The Saxyderms are (to our knowledge) New England's largest non-collegiate saxophone ensemble. The 15-member, Boston-based group has been playing a diverse array of literature including rock, jazz, film and tv scores, and pop since September 2006.

The mission of The Saxyderms is to spread the joy of music to as many people as possible, provide outreach and education to young musicians, and to further enrich the cultural and artistic heritage of Boston.

1780181355.2423336.description: Made up of three Boston-Area natives, Keith Denehy and brothers, Josh and Sean Roberts, have enjoyed playing together for decades. Having played shows for as many as 30,000, they’ve had a nice taste of success. Angry Hill plays mostly rock but has influences from many genres and dabbles in funk, blues rock, and others. They enjoy chilling doing an acoustic show just as much as playing shows for large crowds rocking out with the heavy stuff.

1780246756.2442605.other_genre: Classic 60's rock instrumentals (Ventures, Dick Dale etc.) 60's rock vocals
1780246756.2442605.description: Our band Tsunami of Sound plays all the great surf rock hits from the early days of California surf by bands such as The Ventures up to the more modern surf classics by bands like Los Straightjackets.  It’s 100% dance music, primarily high energy instrumentals with some classic rock hits by The Beatles, Stones, etc.

1780774209.2676951.description: Boston-based singer -songwriter performing originals and covers in the genres of county, folk, rock and blues

1781365811.2890538.description: Locomotive is a loud and energetic hard rock band from Melrose MA playing a mix of both covers and originals.

1781798533.3052391.description: Millennials with instruments. Rock and reimagined pop covers delivering a healthy dose of 90s and 00s.

1781801094.3053966.description: We are a Boston-based band, and we play singer-songwriter originals and a mix of pop/rock/folk covers. Our music is powerful and focuses on conveying emotion through music. We have experience playing for all kinds of crowds, from bars to festivals, and sets consisting of many different genres!

1782162556.3211762.description:
The Strummerville Ukulele Club is a fun-loving, ukulele-strumming, singing and humming group of amateur musicians who love playing songs badly and singing loudly.  
We host ukulele jams twice a month in the Greater Boston area.   

Our hosts, Nick (left) and John (right), guide the group through our beloved songbooks. Our repertoire ranges from classic rock to disco, from traditional folk songs to modern pop, and everything in between.  

We're not here for Grammy nominations; we're here for laughs, occasionally off-key singing, and just enough ukulele strumming to annoy the neighbors!  

Best of all, it's always free! We're all about community building.

1782305143.3255273.other_genre: Blues, Rock, Country, Originals and covers
1782305143.3255273.description: I am a solo performer on acoustic guitar. I play popular covers and original material. I cover Blues, Country, Folk, and Rock. I do not have an online presence.

1782778490.3482264.description: We are an outlaw comedy pirate themed performing group based in New England.  We tell pirate stories, dancing and sing sea shanties.

1782869841.3512696.description: Rec Room is a five-piece rock band formed in Melrose, MA in 2023. Their setlist spans crowd-pleasing favorites from the ’90s and beyond, from bands like Weezer to Tom Petty, delivering familiar songs with energy and tight musicianship. Rec Room features Dan Koehler (guitar/vocals), Nick Twohig (guitar/vocals), Ty Vasapoli (keys/guitar/vocals), Dan Nakhoul (bass), and John Burns (drums).

1782911611.3527938.description: I sing and play Americana/country/bluegrass/folk music!

1783039019.3562371.description: Sounds like Chicken plays songs you know and love, from the Beatles and the Beach Boys to Dua Lipa and Jon Batiste! Come on out and join us for a cluckin' awesome good time!

1783216796.3605135.description: With membahs from Boston to Manchester. Inspired by 80s punk and 50s rock n roll, and so much more. We Are New Englands Premiere Punkabilly Band

1783259006.3612161.description: The Double Lives are a Boston-area rock band that delivers creative covers and original songs with grit, energy, and a modern edge. Driven by powerful vocals, soaring guitars, and thunderous drums, they put their own stamp on familiar songs, turning every set into a high-energy soundtrack for singing along, turning it up, and having a great time.

1783453912.3659279.description: Alien cyborgs here to take over the world through metal!

1783466532.3663841.description: High energy punk from Buffalo NY, with electronics blended in

1783534408.3675827.description: High energy punk/hard rock with themes from The Walking Dead and other horror villain favorites.

1783773673.3741323.description: Much like their name, Greesh is a blend of eclectic influences - taking you from ethereal soundscapes to vibrant psychedelic grooves.

1783828578.3754851.description: Alternative rock from Western Mass, original independent music.

1783886092.3769805.description: I am a DJ/producer from the south shore of Massachusetts.

1783979677.3792828.description: Death and Taxes loves playing for friends, family, and anyone who enjoys great classic rock. We bring upbeat favorites from the 1960s through the 2000s to every show. We’re not calling ourselves a dad band—but we’re probably not fooling anyone.

1784576262.178077.description: Singer/Songwriter who plays fun hooked filled originals with the occasional cover.

1784739267.254074.description:
4 piece rock band (drums, bass, guitar, vocals) playing covers from across the last 6 decades. Covered artists include Elvis, The Beatles, Van Halen, Queen, Led Zeppelin, and more. 

The musicans of the band have lived in and performed around Melrose for decades, while their new singer moved to the city within the last year.

1784840502.282233.description: The Unoriginals are a high-energy Boston-based rock cover band that plays over 100 favorites spanning pop, punk, emo, and alternative rock

1784912728.308694.description: A fresh take on a broad range of rock and R&B hits you’ve been waiting to hear again.

1784931078.315355.description: Two of us, the Andrades, are the hosts at 136 Florence Street. We hosted our band and other performers here at our driveway at previous Porchfests in 2019, 2021, and 2022. We look forward to returning this year! We'll play songs from the 60s, 70s, 80s, 90s, 2000s, and 2010s.

1784992265.340273.actname: Big Cy and The Early Bird Specials
1784992265.340273.description: Hi! We're Big Cy and the Early Bird Specials and we cover hits from the 60s - 00s. Springsteen, Petty, Rolling Stones, Dire Straits, Skynyrd and much more!

1785326163.447697.description: An unpretentious group of individuals past their prime earnestly performing an eclectic collection of familiar favorites with more enthusiasm than polish, punctuated by unexpected song choices and just enough self-awareness to make the whole thing work.

1785344800.452638.description: A spinoff from the Melrose Polymnia Choral Society, the two couples discovered a shared love for pop/rock/folk from the 60s through today – Basically whenever there are guitars and good vocal harmonies. Their first announced public performance will feature classics from The Beatles, Crosby, Stills & Nash, Neil Young, and a few bouncy tunes by The Pretenders, Fountains of Wayne, REM, and the Indigo Girls. There will be plenty to sing along with.

1785367303.459467.description: The Finest, features vocalist Jill Testagrossa and guitarist Randy Pallotta, two friends who have been performing together in various iterations since the early 90s. Playing everything from 90s alternative to 60s classic rock, The Finest brings the big acoustic buzz and energy!

1785462323.510614.other_genre: Blues, country pop, bluegrass etc. A mux
1785462323.510614.description:
Tom Morse is a longtime musician performing all over New England. When not playing electric guitar with his bands he performs a wide mix of acoustic guitar or mandolin with some harmonica thrown in.


Tom draws from a long line of influences including Blues, Country, Americana, Bluegrass and Rock. He performs cover versions and his original compositions. His songs could range from early 1900s to today.

1785529213.551599.description: We met in music school and decided to start a band together; both because that's what you do in music school and as an excuse to hang out. We have been street performing and going to open mics for a while now and have been encouraged to take the next steps of playing actual shows. We like to call ourselves a boyband because we think it's funny.

1785697059.657231.description: We are a high energy dance band, performing timeless Funk, Soul, Disco, R&B classics with some of today's hottest hits, known for our signature Peace, Love & Funk vibe. If you love to dance, this is the band for you!

1785700958.660840.description: Fun rock'n band . Music you can sing and dance to.

1785709018.665772.description: Inertia was formed in 1992 in Medford, Ma. Infusing their collective influences into a creative brew of their own sound, they were a staple of the Boston music scene until their dissolution in 1994. Thirty years later, Inertia has relit the forge and brings new sounds to share and stories to tell.

1785709931.665981.description: Terms like "singer/songwriter" were created with Portland, ME based Jason Roman in mind as those adjectives are his two greatest weapons. He possesses a naturally soulful and inviting voice with well structured, meaningful and memorable songs

1785853121.726101.description:
I am a licensed subway performer in the MBTA.
My music is solo guitar and vocal, focusing on blues predominately but not exclusively from Mississippi - Delta, North MS Hill Country, Bentonia.

1785860691.728704.description: We are a Grateful Dead/psych rock tribute band paying homage to one of the most influential eras in music. On the side, we are all students at Brown University in Providence.

1785883781.738417.description: We are a four piece band based in Somerville that plays original (and a few covers of) melodic rock with infectious choruses.

1785891551.740187.actname: Cammy Kaynor and Tourner a Trois
1785891551.740187.description: Come enjoy a traditional New England Community Contradance (a.k.a. Barn dance) from 2-5PM at Hugos Appliance on Main St., with easy dances for all ages and abilities. From simple squares and circles to longways sets like the Virgina Reel and couples dances like the polka or waltz, there is something for everyone, and each of the dances is taught and prompted by the caller. Tourner a Trois plays a mix of New England, Irish, French Canadian, and Scandinavian tunes; the music alone will make you want to dance!

1786050433.827543.actname: Standup comedy: Elyssa Klein and Friends

1786102391.867055.description: Porchfish plays slide guitar doing mix of Delta Blues and Folk, covering old greats like Son House, Memphis Minnie, and Mississippi Fred McDowell and also original material.

1786412038.1003045.description: Solo acoustic folk and Irish Melrose based musician info can be found on instagram @eamonnsheehanmusic

1786555884.1073159.description: Second Rain is an experimental choral collaborative that focuses on small group a cappella singing.  Our music is a blend of folk, jazz and spiritual styles with a dose of silly and a whole lot of good community vibes.

1786721643.1178388.description: Singer/songwriter from Houlton, ME, relocated to Plymouth, MA about 10 years ago. Songs in the style of The Avett Brothers, Dave Matthews, The Wood Brothers.. Original work with an emphasis on life, family, kids.

1786726368.1182349.description: Solo acoustic act playing favorite singer songwriter tunes from the 70s to today.

1786740876.1192649.description: Two guys, all acoustic, varied styles and genres

1786748162.1196994.description: Alianna Taitano is a lifelong resident of Melrose who, much to the chagrin of her parents, is embarking on a journey in stand up comedy. She will be joined by some of her fellow up and coming comedians, come enjoy and have a laugh!

1786804843.1233954.description: Lobotomobile is a theatrical, avant-garde, multi-genre, alternative-punk trio from Keene NH. We use costumes, visual projections, found audio, folklore, oddities of history, storytelling, unexpected mashups, and pop culture references to create unique performances.

1786886237.1277687.description: Late For Pickup is a local alternative rock band serving a mix of high-energy and acoustic favorites from the 90s and 2000s - with guaranteed good vibes for all!

1786913951.1287516.actname: Andre & the KOC Open Mic All Stars
1786913951.1287516.other_genre: Mostly acoustic (Rock, Pop, Folk, Country) covers from the 60s to present date
1786913951.1287516.description:
We're a group of amateur musicians who play and sing weekly at the Knights of Columbus open mic in Melrose.
We're bringing the great open mic community and experience to Porch Fest.

1786920375.1290013.description: New Mexican Standoff is an energetic and improvisational organ/drum duo, bringing you a mix of original grooves and twisted up classics. Always plenty of surprises, for the band and the audience alike.

1786926549.1292704.description: The Modern Pladz play 1980s "Classic Alternative" college rock such as the Clash, REM, Cure, Squeeze, Elvis Costello, Split Enz, Smiths, Pretenders, Nick Lowe, Crowded House, Romantics, XTC, Cars, English Beat,The Church,with a sprinkling of classic rock such as David Bowie, The Who and Rolling Stones.

1786941454.1300491.description: Melrose-based instrumentalists from the longtime Boston theatrical art-rock troupe Bentmen anchor a fully improvised sonic ride where rock, jazz and ambient music collide.

1787005320.1321761.description: Jerry Sancinito is a local singer-songwriter playing a mix of country/folk and classic rock original songs.  Backed up by local guitar legend Bill Swanson and vocalist Eleanor Maillie.

1787056911.1347977.description:
What's Shakin'?  We are!  The members are all highly talented, semi-pro musicians who have been fortunate to be a part of the New England music scene for many years.

Each brings his own unique style and experience to the show.  What's Shakin' has been rockin' together for 7 years now, during which time we have developed an extensive song list and a strong local following.

1787256389.1452766.description: Area 1306 is Allison and Mark, a newly-formed dad and daughter duo!  Allison is a seasoned veteran of middle school choruses and is entering 9th grade at MHS.  Mark is a guitarist with Melrose-based cover band The Local Ward (also playing at Porchfest), and will accompany Allison on acoustic versions of some of their mutually-favorite rock and pop songs from both dad’s and daughter’s generations.

1787346873.1481538.description: Victoria Tyler is a singer-songwriter and performer whose music blends country, pop, and deeply personal storytelling. For Porchfest, she’ll perform with a three-person band, bringing original songs, strong vocals, and an energetic live sound to the neighborhood.

1787359602.1485253.description: Dynamic piano-driven covers spanning the ’70s through today, featuring powerful vocals, crowd favorites, and an energetic live vibe.

1787673581.1584485.description:
The Jazzabelles is an all-female, big-band style jazz band. Ranging from ballads and big band favorites to Broadway tunes and Latin selections, the band’s music covers a broad spectrum of genres while appealing to a cross-section of audiences and age groups. Since their founding in 2007, the Jazzabelles have performed at popular venues like the Ritz Carlton and Mandarin Oriental hotels in Boston, Riverfest, Waltham as well as at various private functions, night clubs and summer concerts
throughout Massachusetts.

1787674721.1585092.description: Hedy Lamartian is a Northshore-based hard rockin' cover band playing your favorite Gen X and early Gen Y hits, ranging from Led Zeppelin and Rush to Garbage and No Doubt. If power vocals and guitar solos are your thing then come check them out!

1787953640.1664491.description: Four lads from the North Shore with a fondness for stoops! We play a curated selection of your favorite 90s one hit wonders, buzz ballads, 80s bangers, classic rock classics, and a few favorite nursery rhymes thrown in! We aren't afraid to leave our stoop, but we'll be up there until our songs are all done!

1787953768.1664544.actname: Don't Ask Me, I Don't Know
1787953768.1664544.description: Don't Ask Me, I Don't Know is what our teenage drummer said when we asked him what we should call the band, so here we are. We're a collection of family, neighbors, and lifelong friends playing an eclectic mix of rock and folk. While this may be a one-off enterprise, members of the group regularly perform around the area with The Local Ward (John Abdulla), Hot Lunch (Patrick Greene), and Falling to Pieces & Song Garden (Eric Thiebaut).

1788120216.1782019.description: Francis James is a guitarist and songwriter playing originals inspired by Prince, Buddy Holly, Robyn Hitchcock, and 60s legend Donovan. The country he comes from is called the Midwest, but he now makes his home in Melrose.

1788207850.1803570.description: Melrose-based instrumentalists from the longtime Boston theatrical art-rock troupe Bentmen anchor a fully improvised sonic ride where rock, jazz and ambient music collide.

1788208093.1803626.description: Melrose-based instrumentalists from the longtime Boston theatrical art-rock troupe Bentmen anchor a fully improvised sonic ride where rock, jazz and ambient music collide.

1788265058.1821303.description: Join us for a day of traditional Irish music, featuring multiple performers throughout the day!

1788380941.1861872.description: Crow Follow is an original Shaman Rock Band from Boston. Their gritty twin vocals and velvet saxophones bring bright embers to the darkest tunes.

1788381819.1862191.description: Kate sings and plays an electric ukulele and Rich plays bass. Song lists include an array of 50s, 60s, and 70s retro rock / pop hits.

1788638638.2060664.description: Ollie Mann is a soul artist from Austin, Texas, known for his impressive vocals and electric performances. Raised on pagode and samba, he began vocal training at eight years old and picked up multiple instruments along the way. After exploring musical theater, he found his true passion in the energy of live music performance. Now studying songwriting at Berklee College of Music, he builds on the skills he developed, writing across genres, crafting original music, and pitching songs. Whether on stage or in the studio, his sound is rooted in authenticity, rhythm, and a love for connecting through music.

1788638969.2060869.description: Jury's Still Out has been together since 2006. The band is made up of 5 band members from Massachusetts, New Hampshire and Rhode Island. The band plays classic rock songs from 60's to the 2000's, including a few originals.

1788639337.2060946.description: Assembly Required is an electric trio (guitar, keys, jembe, vocals) playing eclectic mix of originals and covers from the 60s, 70s and 80s (Stones, The Band, Neil Young, Beatles, Jimmy Cliff, John Prine, etc.).

1788639804.2061121.description: Dave Dickerson is a singer/songwriter playing mostly originals on keys.

1788639891.2061080.description: Bob Bracker is a singer, songwriter, and keyboardist on keys wgi opkats originals and blues/rock/pop from the great American songbook.

1788640126.2061255.description: Emaline is a Melrose High Sophomore who loves playing her acoustic guitar with a mix of classic covers and original songs.

1789310813.2885452.description: The Party Band is an original brass band embodying homegrown, unadulterated, unplugged fun. Their mission is to bring people together, celebrate the gift of being alive, and make the world a better place through the joys of quality live music in a way that is accessible to everyone.

1789310988.2885431.description: The Electric Heaters are a Boston-based instrumental trio that serve up a cinematic blend of "Retro‑sonic Surf Noir"—imagine reverb‑soaked guitar twang meeting spy, soul, spaghetti‑western, and surf vibes. Led by guitarist Matt Heaton, their music evokes moody, groove‑laden soundtracks for imaginary films, with nods to Morricone, Booker T., Link Wray and The Raybeats. Their debut studio album, From the Film of the Same Name, released in 2022, reimagines forgotten ‘60s–‘80s B‑movie themes with a modern twist. The Electric Heaters bring a chilly North Atlantic surf flair that’s dark, dreamy, and undeniably cinematic—all without uttering a word.

1789503804.3045417.description: Lars Wicklund is a Singer/songwriter and musician from Medford Mass. Drawing influences from the Airborne Toxic Event, John Lennon Tom Petty and the Avett brothers Lars' songs carry a heartfelt messages of unity, peace, positivity and perseverance.
